verdict.rationale: Gecko can be automated without the UI. Its v1 API can trigger scans, read results, triage findings and manage schedules, and an OpenAPI spec is published. API keys are explicitly meant for uses such as a 'CI/CD Pipeline'. PR scans post pass/fail checks to GitHub or GitLab with a configurable fail-on severity, and webhooks push scan and finding events to other systems. missing for 10: a documented CLI or a pipeline-native runner/recipe (e.g. a GitHub Action or GitLab CI job), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
